mentions.claim_text: A shaking comes to Mexico and to Acapulco, with civil unrest and people fleeing toward the border, and a shaking of the corruption in the Mexican government.
mentions.quote: A shaking of Mexico is coming
mentions.falsify_match: A major earthquake or political upheaval in Mexico with unrest and northward migration.

mentions.claim_text: Corruption in the Mexican government is exposed with an overthrowing of things, riots in the streets, pillaging and the cartels involved, naming Claudia.
mentions.quote: I see a overthrowing of things. I see civil unrest
mentions.falsify_match: A governmental crisis in Mexico involving the president and cartel violence.

mentions.claim_text: As Acapulco shakes, San Francisco shakes too.
mentions.quote: AS YOU SEE ALAPOCO SHAKING, YOU WILL SEE SAN FRANCISCO SHAKING
causes: he links the two events directly
mentions.falsify_match: A Mexican Pacific-coast quake followed by a San Francisco quake.
mentions.falsify_miss: Either occurs alone, or neither occurs.

mentions.claim_text: A fire spreads from coast to coast, and ocean water in certain areas begins to boil.
mentions.quote: as the waters IN THE OCEAN IN CERTAIN areas begin to boil
mentions.falsify_match: Reported anomalous sea temperature or submarine volcanic activity.

mentions.claim_text: Magma comes up through a crack in the earth and boils, smelling of sulfur, which he presents as a representation of the lake of fire.
mentions.quote: a magma will begin TO COME FORTH AND BOIL
mentions.falsify_match: A new fissure eruption with sulfur reporting.

mentions.claim_text: A major move of God's presence floods across Africa, starting on the west coast and spreading to the east coast.
mentions.quote: IT WILL START ON THE WEST COAST OF AFRICA AND FLOOD TO THE EAST COAST
mentions.falsify_match: Reported large-scale religious revival moving west to east across Africa.
mentions.falsify_miss: Unfalsifiable in practice: revival has no agreed measure.

mentions.claim_text: Canada is shaken and brought to its knees, which he attributes to pride.
mentions.quote: I will shake Canada as they cry out to me
